shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the marker at 1 beside the gray region in the left image with the marker at −2 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The shaded overlap includes the upper boundary 1. Right image: The highlighted interval excludes its left endpoint −2.
Rationales: The selected left cue includes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue excludes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
